copy.curiosityHook: Framed for a crime they only saw happen, how deep must three loyal companions dig before uncovering who engineered the scheme?
copy.description: In the 1930s, three close friends—a doctor, a nurse, and an attorney—witness a murder and are immediately treated as prime suspects, pulling them into a sprawling, outrageous conspiracy across American history.
copy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful yet playful period mystery that balances moderate emotional weight with an engaging, steady pace.
copy.whyWatch: David O. Russell blends period mystery, fast comedic energy, and drama to turn an escalating historical scheme into a stylish, star-driven investigation.
